verdict.rationale: Mailgun's webhooks documentation says it pushes real-time email event data directly to your application without API polling, which is the product's own outbound HTTP callback capability. The pack does not show which event types are covered or how failed deliveries are retried. Missing for 10: documented delivered/bounced/complained webhook event types, documented retry behavior and schedule, webhook registration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can receive webhooks for delivered, bounced, and complained events with documented retry behavior, so my app reacts to email outcomes in real time

citations.quote: Get real-time email event data sent directly to your application. Automate responses and analytics without API polling.
